spans.s:
नैमित्त a. (त्ती f.) Relating to
signs, marks &c.

नैमित्तिक a. (की f.)
1 Produced
by, connected with, or dependent
on, any particular cause.
--2 Unusual,
occasional, accidental, produced by
some cause (opp. नित्य).
--कः An
astrologer, prophet.
--कं
1 An effect
(opp. निमित्त ‘cause’);
निमित्तनैमित्तिकयोरयं क्रमः Ś. 7. 30.
--2 An
oceasional rite, a periodical ceremony.

नैमिष a. (षी f.) Lasting for a
‘nimisha’ or twinkling, momentary,
transient.
--षं N. of a sacred forest
celebrated as the residence of
certain sages to whom Sauti related the
Mahābhārata;

; (the name
is thus derived: --यतस्तु निमिषेणेदं निहतं
दानवं बलं । अरण्येऽस्मिंस्ततस्तेन
नैमिषारण्यसंज्ञितं ॥).

नैमिषेयः An inhabitant of the
forest, called Naimiṣa.
